::: {.callout-note}
## About this page

This page **tests the document's `desc-position`**: `top` puts the caption and
description above every image, unless the image sets its own `desc-position`. In
the gallery, each image's position applies while it is shown. It is not part of
the website.
:::

## Page setting {expect-open="panzoom" expect-desc-position="top"}

![Chilmark beach at sunset.](../../images/mv-0.jpg){.panzoom description="Chilmark has some of the best beaches." fig-alt="Sunset over a sandy beach, with a tall rock stack against the sun"}
